subject: CaR kickoff — open-vocabulary segmentation without training data
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kicking off the CLIP-as-RNN productization. The method (CaR, from our open-source release) does open-vocabulary segmentation with zero training — a recurrent loop that proposes masks from CLIP and iteratively filters text queries that don't match the image, so it can segment essentially arbitrary concepts. For product teams this means segmentation for long-tail concepts without anyone collecting a labeled dataset first, which is the entire reason three teams have asked for it.

Milestones (Apr 13 – Jul 6): internal demo endpoint by mid-May; benchmark evals reproduced on our harness by early June; hardened batch API + launch review by Jul 6.

Known constraint from the public demo: the SAM-based mask refinement needs GPU serving, CPU-only won't cut it — so this is a Shipyard conversation early.

Jelena, staffing + infra plan please.

Lucia
